issue_title: `@vitest/coverage-istanbul` returns the combined sourcemap where it should be returning the non-combined sourcemap
issue_body:
### Describe the bug

Rollup's transform hook expects `map` to be the sourcemap mapped from the `code` passed to the hook to the `code` returned from the hook.

This `onFileTransform` hook instead returns the `map` from the original `code` (because it passes the result of `getCombinedSourcemap()` to `instrumentSync` and that returns the combined source map)
https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/blob/353ee5bbcb9e1fad3147e067cd8ba1b10ba71da2/packages/coverage-istanbul/src/provider.ts#L65-L83

This causes the sourcemap generated by Vite to be wrong.

### Reproduction

Add
```js
    if (id.endsWith('/math.ts')) {
      console.log(`${code}//# sourceMappingURL=data:application/json;base64,${btoa(JSON.stringify(map))}`)
    }
```
after this line:
https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/blob/353ee5bbcb9e1fad3147e067cd8ba1b10ba71da2/packages/coverage-istanbul/src/provider.ts#L81

This is the result I got locally: [sourcemap visualizer](https://evanw.github.io/source-map-visualization/#)
The input TS file is shown as the original file. But the JS file should be shown here as it is already transformed to JS by Vite.
